header.court: DeKalb County, Georgia (Judge Alvin Wong; prosecuted by the DeKalb County Solicitor-General)
header.charge: one count of cruelty to animals (misdemeanor); a second count was dropped
header.sentence: 10 days in DeKalb County Jail (2 days credit) + 1 year of probation; 24 anger-management classes, 100 hours community service, animal-cruelty program, no dogs during probation, $3,048 to LifeLine (FOX 5; CBS: more than $3,300)
header.finality: Non-negotiated guilty plea; no appeal reported in any source (checked 2026-11-13).
header.pronouns: she/her for the streamer (FOX 5, CBS, Decaturish all use her/she); the judge is never given a pronoun on screen.
